description: Start here, before get_figure, to find selected figures in Australian retirement rules: rates, amounts, caps, thresholds, ages, periods and dates for the Age Pension and its means tests, superannuation and the Division 293 and 296 taxes, deeming, the Commonwealth Seniors Health Card, aged care and the Home Equity Access Scheme. Searches by keyword, category or both, and returns each match's id and current value. Each current value has an official source, the date it applies from and the date it was last checked; get_figure returns them.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, such as aged_care.

limit.description: The most results to return. Default 10, maximum 50.

query.description: Words to look for, such as "concessional cap" or "deeming rate". Up to 100 characters.

name: search_figures

data_release.description: The number of the data release these values come from.

effective_from.description: The date the value applies from. effective_from_basis says what the date means.

effective_from_basis.description: value: the day this value started. provision: the day the current rule started; the number itself is older. as_at: a day the official source shows the value in force; the day it started is not recorded.

review_due.description: True when a scheduled review day has come since the figure was last checked against its source. get_figure gives the day and a note.

scope.description: What this site does and does not provide.

truncated.description: True when there are more items than this result holds.

title: Search figures
